summary: The "RptMnuFixedTermAppointments" page is a web control used for generating reports on fixed-term appointments. It includes functionalities for selecting date ranges, running Excel exports, and displaying the report contents.
purpose: Provide a user interface for generating fixed-term appointment reports, including date range selection and export options.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.purpose: Input field for the start date of the report range.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.purpose: Input field for the end date of the report range.

fields.name: ltlDescription
fields.purpose: Displays the description of the report.

fields.name: ltlOptions
fields.purpose: Displays options or notes related to the report.

fields.name: lblReportHTML
fields.purpose: Displays the generated report in HTML format.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Interacts with the report interface to generate and view reports.

workflows.name: Generate Fixed Term Appointment Report
steps: User selects a start date using txtStartDate.
User selects an end date using txtEndDate.
User clicks cmdExcel to generate the report.
System executes stored procedure 'ReportFixedTermAppointments' with selected dates.
System outputs report in CSV format and displays as HTML.

validations.name: valEditStartDate
validations.purpose: Ensures that the start date is entered.

validations.name: valEditEndDate
validations.purpose: Ensures that the end date is entered.

validations.name: RegularExpressionValidator1
validations.purpose: Validates the format of the start date.

validations.name: RegularExpressionValidator2
validations.purpose: Validates the format of the end date.

system_behavior: Upon loading, the system checks for a valid user session and retrieves report details.
When Excel export button is clicked, the system calls a stored procedure and processes the output.
The system sets up JavaScript variables for UI interaction.
Displays waiting message while report is generated.
